caption: The drawing depicts a square textile featuring a woven design of alternating square panels, with intricate traditional patterns. The textile is primarily composed of three colors: navy blue, red, and white. The design includes large floral and foliate motifs in the blue-on-white and blue-on-red squares, while the border and a few of the square panels display more geometric and stylized floral patterns. The textile is bordered on two sides by a visible fringe, composed of intermixed blue, red, and white threads. One corner of the textile is folded over itself, revealing the reverse side, which displays a mirrored and more faded version of the front's pattern. The textile lays flat on a plain, light-colored background. The pattern and colors are woven and the drawing shows a clear delineation between the textile and the background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
